subject: Loadproof handshake: Nimbus onboarding benchmark plan
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Loadproof handshake: Nimbus onboarding benchmark plan

Hi Dana —

Great to kick this off. Following our intro call last week, attached is a first-pass benchmark plan for the Nimbus onboarding we discussed. Goal of this thread: align acceptance criteria (latency / throughput), lock a test schedule, and confirm what evidence Nimbus needs to sign off.

Quick summary / asks:
- Proposed test window: Tue 11 May (smoke + steady-state) and Wed 12 May (stress / tail latency). Please confirm local team availability.
- Targets we’ll validate (initial): p95 latency < 220 ms for 512-token generation; p99 < 600 ms; steady-state throughput target 120 req/s with 1.5x burst to 300 req/s for 60s.
- Artifacts attached: nimbus_test_plan_v1.xlsx (test cases & schedule), redwood-benchmark-runbook.pdf (how we run/collect metrics).
- Please attach your internal SLOs / acceptance matrix if you have one (SLO examples attached would be helpful).

We’ll run tests from Redwood Dedicated capacity (same runtime used in certs) and share raw logs + telemetry. If anything needs to be changed (e.g., tokens / prompt shapes, different concurrency), reply with specifics and we’ll adapt.

Next steps: confirm 1) test window, 2) internal SLO matrix file, 3) primary Nimbus contact for the run (ops@ or a named engineer). I’ll schedule the runs once you confirm.

Thanks —
Rafael Mendes
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com
Attachment: nimbus_test_plan_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), redwood-benchmark-runbook.pdf (doc)

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 07:55:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Loadproof handshake: Nimbus onboarding benchmark plan

Thanks Dana — appreciate the SLO file. I updated the plan and added explicit test cases + acceptance gates. Full plan highlights below and in the attached workbook.

Planned test matrix (summary)
- Smoke (10m): connectivity, model variant check, KV-cache warm-up (expected warm-up: ~3 min).
- Steady-state (30m): maintain 120 req/s with realistic prompt shapes (mix A/B: 60/40). Acceptance if p95 < 220ms and error rate < 0.5%.
- Burst stress (5 x 60s spikes): ramp to 300 req/s for 60s, recover to steady-state. Monitor queueing and tail latency (5-min windows).
- Tail sweep (30m): hit long-tail requests (2k+ tokens) to validate p99 behavior for large outputs.

Acceptance gating (pass/fail):
- p95 across steady-state buckets <= 220ms
- p99 across stress + tail buckets <= 600ms
- Overall error rate during steady-state < 0.5%
- No persistent OOMs / missing KV-caches (transients documented)

Schedule (UTC):
- Tue 11 May 14:00 - 17:00 UTC: Smoke + Steady-state run (live monitoring)
- Wed 12 May 13:00 - 16:00 UTC: Burst stress + Tail sweep + artifact collection

Artifacts we will deliver after each run:
- Raw traces + latency histograms (JSON)
- Aggregated CSV summary (p50/p95/p99, error rates)
- Run log and any captured stderr from the serving runtime

Links / artifacts: redwood runbook (attached), Google Drive folder (shared): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AbCdefMockLink
HubSpot deal for this onboarding: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567

If that looks good we’ll proceed to run Tue morning (your time). Please confirm and I’ll kick off scheduling on our side.

Rafael
Attachment: updated_nimbus_test_plan_v2.xlsx, redwood-benchmark-runbook.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 18:25:00 +0000
Subject: RE: Loadproof handshake: Nimbus onboarding benchmark plan

Forwarding quick results summary from the run we executed earlier today (11 May, steady-state + smoke). See attached run log for full traces.

> On Tue, 11 May 2027 at 07:55 -0700 Rafael Mendes wrote:
> > Planned test matrix (summary)
> > - Smoke (10m)
> > - Steady-state (30m)
> > - Burst stress ...

Run summary (11 May steady-state)
- Duration: 30m steady-state window
- Target concurrency: 120 req/s (realized median: 130 req/s)
- p50: 60 ms | p95: 185 ms | p99: 480 ms
- Error rate (server 5xx + client timeouts): 0.22% total during steady-state
- Observed transient: one pod hit a short-lived OOM at 13:07 UTC; container auto-restarted and recovered within ~45s. We captured the stderr and GC traces in the attached run log.

Initial assessment: Steady-state acceptance gates met (p95 < 220ms, error < 0.5%). Tail behavior during the controlled tail-sweep (we ran a short one) showed p99 under 500ms for the sampled long outputs, but we recommend running the full tail sweep tomorrow as planned.

Attachments: nimbus_run_05-11-2027.json (run log, 120MB truncated reference)

Ben Carter
Performance Engineer | Redwood Inference
